ValidationRule.description: Non-draft projects must start and kick off in the same ISO year within a priority-driven number of ISO weeks, end within a clamped month horizon, avoid unexempted weekend starts, and avoid year-end starts that fall in the wrong quarter-month window.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Kickoff_At__c)), IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft'), FALSE, OR( End_Date__c < Start_Date__c, ISOYEAR(DATEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c)) <> ISOYEAR(Start_Date__c), ABS(ISOWEEK(DATEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c)) - ISOWEEK(Start_Date__c)) > CASE(TEXT(Priority__c), 'Critical', 1, 'High', 2, 4), End_Date__c > ADDMONTHS(Start_Date__c, MIN(36, MAX(12, CASE(TEXT(Priority__c), 'Critical', 12, 'High', 24, 36)))), AND( OR(WEEKDAY(Start_Date__c) = 1, WEEKDAY(Start_Date__c) = 7), NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(Priority__c, 'Critical'), DAYOFYEAR(Start_Date__c) = 1)), IF( CASE(MONTH(Start_Date__c), 12, 1, 1, 1, 0) = 1, DAY(Start_Date__c) > 20, DATE(YEAR(Start_Date__c), MONTH(Start_Date__c), 1) < ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), -120) ) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Project calendar (ISO week/year, horizon, weekend or year-end start) is not allowed.
